| AWF-0061 | [Quote-verified synthesis](workflows/TEC/PRD/UXR/quote-verified-synthesis/) | Check 100% of quotes against the source transcripts and leave sentiment judgments to people; even temperature 0.1 did not prevent invented quotations. |
| AWF-0063 | [Diff-proven dbt migration](workflows/TEC/DAT/DATAENG/diff-proven-dbt-migration/) | Every model is proven by a row-level diff against production data; a two-way comparison with a row-count check catches an incremental watermark that silently drops NULL and late rows. |
| AWF-0066 | [Chat-to-IaC change](workflows/TEC/ITS/INFRA/chat-to-iac-change/) | Reviewers approve the plan output posted on the pull request, not the code diff: a small-looking diff can replace or destroy resources. |
| AWF-0069 | [Filtered test augmentation](workflows/TEC/SWE/TEST/filtered-test-augmentation/) | Filter generated tests through build, pass, 5 reruns and coverage gain before review; only about 4–5% survive, and each surviving test gets its own small diff. |
| AWF-0071 | [Reproduce-first bug fix](workflows/TEC/SWE/DEBUG/reproduce-first-bug-fix/) | The bug is reproduced before any fix, and the same reproduction is rerun with the same sample size afterwards; a second case worded differently guards against fitting the report's exact wording. |
| AWF-0073 | [Dossier-to-chapter book](workflows/CRE/WRI/NONFIC/dossier-to-chapter-book/) | Require live URLs for Tier 1 sources, use DOI placeholders for unretrieved material, and audit citations with a second model; the account admits not every citation was independently verified. |
| AWF-0077 | [Transcript-first video edit](workflows/CRE/MED/POST/transcript-first-video-edit/) | Re-transcribe the exact final video export for captions rather than a proxy file, which can shift timing; run a jargon-dictionary check and watch the finished cut. |
| AWF-0080 | [Theme sign-off consultation analysis](workflows/ORG/GOV/POLICY/theme-sign-off-consultation-analysis/) | Two people first review the same mappings to set a human-versus-human baseline (F1 0.710), and the model is judged against that; reviewers can flag 'no theme fits', which reopens the theme list. |
| AWF-0091 | [Writer-reviewed CSR draft](workflows/PRO/HLT/CLINTRIAL/writer-reviewed-csr-draft/) | Map and validate the clinical data tables before drafting the study report, then run automated draft checks before qualified medical writers review the entire document. |
| AWF-0102 | [Guardrailed course tutor](workflows/PRO/EDU/TUTOR/guardrailed-course-tutor/) | Have teaching fellows compare old and new tutor answers pairwise before prompt changes roll out, and calibrate model-graded evaluation to their choices instead of just lengthening the prompt. |
| AWF-0104 | [Hypothesis tournament](workflows/PRO/RES/LITREV/hypothesis-tournament/) | Treat tournament Elo as model ranking rather than ground truth; scientists assess the top hypotheses and validate them in the lab before calling them discoveries. |
| AWF-0109 | [Inbound qualify-and-book agent](workflows/COM/SAL/PROSPECT/inbound-qualify-and-book/) | Before disqualifying an interrupted or unsuccessful sales call, fall back to website analysis and grants checks; people score every conversation daily and tune the criteria. |
| AWF-0111 | [Catalog copy factory](workflows/COM/RET/CATALOG/catalog-copy-factory/) | Run only SKUs with complete product data and build the copy-rule checker from the same text specification as the writing brief; unsupported claims still get fact review. |
| AWF-0112 | [Confidence-sampled attribute extraction](workflows/COM/RET/CATALOG/confidence-sampled-attribute-extraction/) | Use an independent verifier for attribute confidence rather than trusting the extractor’s self-report; auditors correct low-confidence values and sample for catalog drift. |
| AWF-0115 | [Tiered-permission ads optimizer](workflows/COM/MKT/ADS/tiered-permission-ads-optimizer/) | Execute ad changes only within permission tiers and cross-check ads against analytics for tracking anomalies; budget raises, campaign switches and measurement changes remain human-gated. |
| AWF-0116 | [Agent-drafted PCB schematic](workflows/TEC/ENG/CAD/agent-drafted-pcb-schematic/) | Use netlist inspection, a second engineer and bench bring-up to catch circuit faults the model misses; a shorted switch pin held BOOT0 low despite the schematic review. |
| AWF-0123 | [Scheduled metric commentary](workflows/TEC/DAT/ANALYTICS/scheduled-metric-commentary/) | Test metric moves against 6-month variability and the same period last year before writing commentary; the tagged owner edits the published report and those edits sync back to context. |
| AWF-0126 | [Calibrated-judge quality loop](workflows/TEC/DAT/MLOPS/calibrated-judge-quality-loop/) | Calibrate the judge against held-out human labels, recalibrate when rubrics change, and test proposed fixes in a fixture-pinned simulator before shipping. |
| AWF-0128 | [Detonate-and-confirm detections](workflows/TEC/ITS/SECOPS/detonate-and-confirm-detections/) | Run attack simulations on lab hosts and re-query the SIEM for raw events and rule matches; a devcontainer and egress rules limit unattended agents that might change out-of-scope configuration. |
| AWF-0132 | [Streak-verified flake fix](workflows/TEC/SWE/TEST/streak-verified-flake-fix/) | One green rerun proves nothing for an intermittent failure, so a fix counts only after a clean streak of N reruns; each fixer tries one hypothesis and a separate verifier judges only the target test. |
| AWF-0135 | [Release-cycle docs skill](workflows/CRE/WRI/TECHW/release-cycle-docs-skill/) | Cross-check release notes against changelists, stage labels against YAML and screenshots with a sub-agent; fold writer comments back into each product’s skill before the next release. |
| AWF-0136 | [Term-gated game localisation](workflows/CRE/WRI/TRANS/term-gated-game-localisation/) | Mine and approve term pairs each game version before translation, then run format and terminology rules plus expert LQA; the rule layer covers 70%+ of format and term issues. |
| AWF-0141 | [Gap-checked benefits form fill](workflows/ORG/GOV/CASEWORK/gap-checked-benefits-form-fill/) | Run a form gap analysis before filling, let the caseworker and client gather missing items, and show why each field was pulled so stale agency records can be corrected. |
| AWF-0143 | [Officer-checked planning data extraction](workflows/ORG/GOV/CIVIC/officer-checked-planning-data-extraction/) | Check extracted boundaries with IoU and centre distance, then have an officer inspect every output rather than samples; high-looking accuracy can increase over-trust. |
| AWF-0144 | [Manager-approved pipeline actions](workflows/ORG/BIZ/HR/manager-approved-pipeline-actions/) | Flag missing applicant data rather than auto-archiving, and re-query Gmail, WAAS and Ashby after approved actions before reporting completion, so a silent write failure is not missed. |
| AWF-0147 | [Analyst-verified lease abstracts](workflows/unplaced/analyst-verified-lease-abstracts/) | Read amendments in order with the original lease and cite every extracted value; an analyst signs off every field because partially accurate lease data is unusable. |
| AWF-0157 | [Nightly hospital-course drafts](workflows/PRO/HLT/CLINDOC/nightly-hospital-course-drafts/) | Give each hospital-course draft inline source citations for physician checking; omissions affected 25% and inaccuracies 20% of rated summaries, so adoption alone is not evidence of time saved. |
| AWF-0159 | [Sample-tuned contract abstraction](workflows/PRO/LEG/CONTRACT/sample-tuned-contract-abstraction/) | Tune field-specific extraction prompts with attorneys on a representative contract sample before scaling; hyperlink each extracted field to its source text for validation. |
| AWF-0160 | [Sampled DSAR disclosure](workflows/PRO/LEG/REG/sampled-dsar-disclosure/) | Sample documents labeled not relevant to catch missed personal data, then QC redactions, exemptions and privilege before disclosure; negotiate request scope before collection. |
| AWF-0161 | [Page-cited medical chronology](workflows/PRO/LEG/LITIG/page-cited-medical-chronology/) | Attach a page citation to every medical-chronology event and have a paralegal or attorney check each against the original page before it enters case preparation. |
| AWF-0163 | [Summarised GP-report underwriting](workflows/PRO/INS/UW/summarised-gp-report-underwriting/) | Validate medical-report summaries across conditions before extending coverage; start with lower-risk cases after 18 months of testing and keep post-application audits. |
| AWF-0167 | [AI-blended comparative judgement](workflows/PRO/EDU/ASSESS/ai-blended-comparative-judgement/) | The AI is 'right 80% of the time, and wrong when it matters most', so teachers look at the size of disagreements, not the agreement rate; a 10% human share means every script is still seen twice by a person. |
| AWF-0168 | [Lab-in-the-loop discovery](workflows/PRO/RES/ANALYSIS/lab-in-the-loop-discovery/) | Run 8 analysis trajectories on the same wet-lab data and combine them by consensus; scientists perform the experiments and re-analyze and replicate promising results. |
| AWF-0171 | [Backtested synthetic panel](workflows/COM/MKT/MKTRES/backtested-synthetic-panel/) | Backtest synthetic respondents against a held-out human study before insights-lead approval; elicit free text and map it to ratings to avoid narrow, overly positive direct scores. |
| AWF-0172 | [Simulation release gate](workflows/COM/CSX/QA/simulation-release-gate/) | The simulator is tested first: does it rank shipped versions the way production did? Blinded reviewers still spotted most simulated conversations, so ranking agreement is the test that matters. |
| AWF-0173 | [Code-change doc refresh](workflows/COM/CSX/KB/code-change-doc-refresh/) | Draft passage-level diffs rather than whole-article rewrites, and have a second model check them against the code diff; merge triggers drafting, but customer availability gates publication. |
| AWF-0176 | [RFQ-to-quote drafting](workflows/COM/SAL/DEAL/rfq-to-quote-drafting/) | Try deterministic SKU-code matching before model matching, cite the source for every quote line, and flag low-confidence or off-policy prices for the rep to confirm. |
| AWF-0179 | [Spec-PR then agent build](workflows/TEC/SWE/FEAT/spec-pr-then-agent-build/) | Check every spec claim against real code before the team merges the spec PR, then get a contrarian verdict; this caught a false configuration premise that questioning alone missed. |
| AWF-0181 | [Scenario release sweep](workflows/TEC/SWE/TEST/scenario-release-sweep/) | A separate verifier confirms scenario failures and looks for causes in code before human triage; keep unit tests as merge gates because agent-driven release sweeps are non-deterministic. |
| AWF-0182 | [Risk-gated auto-approval](workflows/TEC/SWE/REVIEW/risk-gated-auto-approval/) | Whether a pull request may be auto-approved is decided first by deterministic rules (path, size, base branch, labels); prompt changes are backtested on past pull requests, including the one approved wrongly. |
| AWF-0187 | [Purple-team detection build](workflows/TEC/ITS/SECOPS/purple-team-detection-build/) | Detonate more than 5 technique variants per detection rule, then test against operational telemetry before review; catching one PoC is not enough to establish durable detection. |
| AWF-0189 | [Self-repair before handoff](workflows/TEC/ITS/HELPDESK/self-repair-before-handoff/) | Allow only known safe VM repairs and hand risky cases to support; test each supported Windows version on deliberately broken VMs before releasing repairs. |
| AWF-0192 | [Context-tested Slack analyst](workflows/TEC/DAT/ANALYTICS/context-tested-slack-analyst/) | Test the context layer end to end and audit public Slack threads instead of approving every answer; answers expose their SQL and use endorsed datasets. |
| AWF-0193 | [Unattended simulation campaign](workflows/TEC/ENG/SIM/unattended-simulation-campaign/) | Calibrate the base simulation against measurements before the campaign, then check every run for plausibility; a solver can report success at the wrong equilibrium. |
| AWF-0205 | [Exemption-cited records redaction](workflows/ORG/GOV/CIVIC/exemption-cited-records-redaction/) | Cite an exemption for each proposed redaction and have a records officer approve it; explicitly configure which routine request types may bypass review and keep sensitive ones on full review. |
| AWF-0213 | [Cited interconnection readiness review](workflows/unplaced/cited-interconnection-readiness-review/) | Link every grid-interconnection readiness assessment to the source page and clause; grid engineers keep the final compliance determination instead of relying on a black-box verdict. |
| AWF-0216 | [Agent-researched trading signals](workflows/PRO/FIN/INVEST/agent-researched-trading-signals/) | Apply the same research thresholds to agent-generated trading ideas and check consistency between hypothesis, code and evaluation; high idea volume increases the risk of p-hacking. |
| AWF-0221 | [Formulary-checked discharge supply](workflows/unplaced/formulary-checked-discharge-supply/) | Have pharmacists verify every supply decision with special attention to omitted medicines; after a dispensing-format change, re-evaluate on a fresh 100-prescription sample before continued use. |
| AWF-0223 | [Confirmed-inputs QBR deck](workflows/COM/CSX/CS/confirmed-inputs-qbr-deck/) | Save account-manager-confirmed judgments as structured inputs from one account snapshot, then QA the deck against them; include owned products to avoid recommending modules the customer already has. |
| AWF-0224 | [Diffed article refresh](workflows/COM/MKT/CONTENT/diffed-article-refresh/) | Audit product mentions and show the refreshed article as a side-by-side diff against the original, making invented features and unintended edits visible to the editor. |
| AWF-0225 | [Ranker-guided creative slate](workflows/COM/MKT/LIFECYCLE/ranker-guided-creative-slate/) | The offline ranker is not used as a deployment rule (its top pick ranked 43rd online); it only builds a high-recall slate, and the online test picks the winner after one refinement round. |
| AWF-0228 | [QA-agent competitive brief](workflows/ORG/BIZ/STRAT/qa-agent-competitive-brief/) | Use a separate QA agent to check each competitive claim against dated sources and internal product docs; pull unsupported claims before the PM approves battlecard edits. |
| AWF-0231 | [Designer-authored UI PR](workflows/TEC/PRD/UI/designer-authored-ui-pr/) | Require linters, CI, tests, a running preview and engineering review on designer-authored PRs; keep those changes to the frontend and pair on complex features. |
| AWF-0233 | [Pre-transmission entry audit](workflows/ORG/LOG/CUSTOMS/pre-transmission-entry-audit/) | Audit every prepared customs entry against a centrally maintained rule set before transmission; route only breaches for correction and keep classification correctness as a separate upstream review. |
| AWF-0234 | [Agent-built replenishment plans](workflows/unplaced/agent-built-replenishment-plans/) | Break planning data work into atomic, auditable operations so faults can be traced to data, slot extraction, aggregation or tools; keep monitoring execution deviations after plan adoption. |
| AWF-0235 | [Rule-set verdict review](workflows/TEC/ENG/SUBMITTAL/rule-set-verdict-review/) | Confirm the reconciled General and Particular Specifications before checking submissions; each rule verdict shows highlighted evidence and each override needs a written reason. |
| AWF-0236 | [Agronomist-gated push advisories](workflows/ORG/AGR/ADVISORY/agronomist-gated-push-advisories/) | A/B-test voiced crop advisories before scaling and compare scripts with agronomists; final results showed AI listening rates 2–3.5 pp lower, contrary to the project page’s preliminary claim. |
| AWF-0237 | [Cited outage revalidation](workflows/unplaced/cited-outage-revalidation/) | Re-check outages at D+21, D+2 and D+1, validate each agent before integration, and cite every finding; operators make corrections and the agents take no autonomous grid actions. |
